title: 第25章 震撼的消息第26章 萧鼎锋的应对
slug: 穿成皇子六连抽建立万古帝朝
lines: “什么？你从哪里打听来的消息？”萧风还没有说什么，呼延墨岩听着消息突然从椅子上坐起来了，问道。
“这次来到三朝代表，在一个月前，在紫云王朝已经秘密会面过了，谈话内容只有三朝的代表知道，其余人员都不清楚，但是根据锦衣卫传来的消息，汇总来看，三朝应该是敲定了什么秘密协议，三朝有一部分高手都秘密的消失了，暂时还没有查出来，他们的去处，还有就是不良人也传来消息，说有部分宗门的人也消失了，暂时不知去向。”
听完袁天罡带来的消息，萧风一时间不知道在想什么，而呼延墨岩听完这个消息，是感到非常震撼的，不止是因为三朝的密谋，而是袁天罡说出的消息来源，明显不是同一个势力，就连陛下都不一定对每个王朝有这么大的渗透力度，而萧风却能在这么快的时间得到消息，虽然没有带来确切的消息，但是也足够了，至少现在他们也不是一无所知。
呼延墨岩看着袁天罡，毕竟他们没有过袁天罡出手的记录，连陛下也不知道，许褚和赵云，贾诩和曹正淳这都是出现在萧风身边的人，陛下早已调查过，虽然身份背景没有错，但是这突然冒出来的这个人，他和陛下都是没有见过的，这不禁又让他多想了起来。
或许是看出来呼延墨岩的神情有些不自然，萧风开口道：“岳父大人，这是我的情报组织头目，类似于陛下的暗卫，也会负责我的保卫工作，至于他刚刚说的两个势力，也是情报机构，只不过分工不同罢了。岳父大人不必担心。”
呼延墨岩听完萧风的解释，也没有说什么，只是点了点头。
随后萧风又对袁天罡说：“安排些人再来丞相府，保护岳父大人和王妃的安全，你亲自来办，让朱无视先替你管其他的事情，等解决了四朝比试，再做其他的安排。”
“是，殿下，属下这就去和朱无视交接一下，还有殿下，王府中其他的眼线要不要全部除掉？”袁天罡说完便看向了萧风。
萧风也是侧头看向了呼延墨岩，呼延墨岩看着望过来的萧风，问道：“都是哪些人？”
“都有，几位皇子，还有陛下的，但是陛下派来的应该是暗卫，保护丞相的，其他的都是将丞相府的消息传出去的，还有一个比较特殊的，是迎春楼的，但是她什么都没有干，就是单纯的在府里，她的暴露是因为迎春楼有个人供出她了。”
“迎春楼？不是个青楼吗？为何会派人关注我？”呼延墨岩也是没想明白。
萧风解释道：“迎春楼，不是表面上的那么简单，岳父大人不用去理会，后面我会处理的。”
呼延墨岩点了点头，开口道：“那就将皇子的眼线全部拔除吧，其余的不用理会了，人多吗？”
袁天罡点了点头，他不想告诉呼延墨岩，他府邸大部分都是，于是开口道：“我这几天安排，然后将不良人安排进来，进行替换。”
呼延墨岩听后并没有多说，萧风开口道：“你和朱无视说一下，让他尽快查出那些消失人的去向，还有就是如果能探出他们秘密会谈内容的话，尽量探听，但是不要暴露，现在还不是暴露的时候，另外，让护龙山庄的人开始往燕京城靠拢，我预感到这次的四朝比试不会那么简单。”
“是，殿下，我现在就去办，之后，我会直接潜伏在丞相府，确保丞相府无恙，如果王妃外出，我会安排天罡的人进行保护。”
“嗯，去吧。”萧风示意袁天罡下去。
萧风随后便对呼延墨岩说：“岳父大人，刚刚袁天罡说的，你可以私下和陛下说一下，这个消息，对我们来说不是什么好事情，虽然我并不惧怕这些事情，但是对于旭日王朝来说，可不是什么好事情。”
“嗯，我明白，我一会就进宫和陛下说，让他提前，做准备，要不要直接让暗卫通知陛下？”
“不行，这种事情，不适合他们知道，我之所以从听轩小筑出来就是因为当时有人刺杀，事后陛下和我说我身边一直是有暗卫保护的，但是当时救我的禁军当晚的巡逻小队，还有刘公公，而不是暗卫，虽然陛下解释当时是所有暗卫换班换防，我却不信，那就说明暗卫中有人是内鬼，我一直在查，但是暗卫的身份本来就不好查，所以，我现在还没有线索，我也不能明面上查，毕竟那是父皇的秘密，所以我还是不信任暗卫的。”
呼延墨岩也是第一次知道萧风在皇宫被刺杀的事情，开口问道：“刺杀之人是谁？”
萧风摇了摇头，“父皇没有明说，但是他应该知道了吧。其实是谁，对我来说不重要，反而要感谢他，要不是他，我也不会从冷宫中出来。”
呼延墨岩没有说什么，只是点了点头。
萧风随后便问贾诩：“文和，对刚刚袁天罡说的事情怎么看。”

贾诩思考了一会儿，便说道：“回殿下，刚刚袁天罡带来的情报，无非就是两点，第一便是三大王朝合谋要对旭日王朝出手，而宗门消失的高手大概率也是参与这件事；第二便是通过四朝比试，试探出足够多的旭日王朝的底牌，但是这件事我总觉得不会那么简单，没有足够的利益，三大王朝和宗门的人，不可能这么大费周章的做这些事情，应该是有人诱导着这些势力对旭日王朝动手，或者说旭日王朝有什么值得让这么多势力联手掠夺后，瓜分的东西，殿下，我觉得您应该让锦衣卫和不良人加大力度了，没有情报，我们做什么都没办法应对，现在只能是做些准备了，目前还是缺人手。”说完贾诩就看向了萧风，给了萧风一个眼神。
萧风看着贾诩的眼神，也知道他是什么意思，只是现在没办法说，于是开口道：“我知道了，我会再调些人来燕京城。”
呼延墨岩听完贾诩的分析，也是对贾诩有了新的认识，贾诩将刚刚袁天罡带来的消息，全部汇总成了关键信息，他一会儿和陛下可以直接这要说就行了。

content_en:
"What? Where did you get the news?" Before Xiao Feng said anything, Huyan Moyan suddenly sat up from his chair after hearing the news and asked.
"The representatives of the Three Dynasties who came this time met secretly in the Ziyun Dynasty a month ago. Only the representatives of the Three Dynasties knew the content of the conversation, and the rest of the people did not know. However, according to the news from Jin Yiwei, it seems that the Three Dynasties must have finalized some secret agreement. Some of the masters of the Three Dynasties have secretly disappeared, and they have not been found out yet. Their whereabouts, and bad people have also sent news that some people from the sect have also disappeared, and their whereabouts are unknown for the time being."
After hearing the news brought by Yuan Tiangang, Xiao Feng didn't know what he was thinking for a while, and Huyan Moyan was very shocked after hearing the news. Not only because of the conspiracy of the three dynasties, but also because the source of the information Yuan Tiangang told was obviously not the same force. Even His Majesty may not have such great penetration into each dynasty, but Xiao Feng was able to get the news so quickly. Although he did not bring the exact news, it was enough, at least now they are not ignorant.
Huyan Moyan looked at Yuan Tiangang. After all, they had no record of Yuan Tiangang taking action. Even His Majesty did not know that Xu Chu, Zhao Yun, Jia Xu and Cao Zhengchun were all people who appeared next to Xiao Feng. His Majesty had already investigated it. Although his identity and background were correct, neither he nor His Majesty had seen this person who suddenly appeared, which made him think more.
Perhaps seeing that Huyan Moyan's expression was a little unnatural, Xiao Feng said: "Father-in-law, this is the head of my intelligence organization, similar to His Majesty's secret guard, and will also be responsible for my security. As for the two forces he just mentioned, they are also intelligence agencies, but the division of labor is different. Father-in-law, don't worry."
After hearing Xiao Feng's explanation, Huyan Moyan didn't say anything and just nodded.
Xiao Feng then said to Yuan Tiangang: "Arrange some people to come to the Prime Minister's Mansion to protect the safety of your father-in-law and the princess. You can do it yourself and let Zhu Wuwu take care of other things for you first. After the Four Dynasties Competition is resolved, we can make other arrangements."
"Yes, Your Highness, I will go and explain to Zhu Wuwu now, and Your Highness, do you want to get rid of all the other informants in the palace?" After Yuan Tiangang said that, he looked at Xiao Feng.
Xiao Feng also turned his head and looked at Huyan Moyan. Huyan Moyan looked at Xiao Feng who was looking over and asked, "Who are they?"
"They are all there, several princes, and His Majesty's, but the ones His Majesty sent should be secret guards to protect the Prime Minister. The others are to spread the news about the Prime Minister's Mansion. There is also a special one, who is from Yingchun Tower, but she did nothing, she was simply in the mansion. She was exposed because someone from Yingchun Tower confessed to her."
"Yingchun Tower? Isn't it a brothel? Why would you send people to pay attention to me?" Huyan Moyan also didn't understand.
Xiao Feng explained: "Yingchun Tower is not as simple as it seems on the surface. Father-in-law, you don't need to pay attention to it. I will deal with it later."
Huyan Moyan nodded and said, "Then remove all the prince's eyeliners and ignore the rest. Are there many people?"
Yuan Tiangang nodded. He didn't want to tell Huyan Moyan that most of his residences were filled with people, so he said: "I will make arrangements in the past few days, and then arrange for the bad guys to come in and replace them."
Huyan Moyan didn't say much after hearing this. Xiao Feng said: "You and Zhu Wuwu should talk to him and ask him to find out the whereabouts of the disappeared people as soon as possible. If he can find out the contents of their secret talks, try to find out the content of their secret talks, but don't expose them. Now is not the time to expose them. In addition, let the people of Hulong Villa start to move closer to Yanjing City. I have a feeling that this Four Dynasties competition will not be that simple."
"Yes, Your Highness, I will do it now. After that, I will lurk directly in the Prime Minister's Mansion to ensure that the Prime Minister's Mansion is safe. If the princess goes out, I will arrange for people from Tiangang to protect her."
"Well, let's go." Xiao Feng motioned Yuan Tiangang to go down.
Xiao Feng then said to Huyan Moyan: "Father-in-law, as Yuan Tiangang just said, you can tell His Majesty in private that this news is not a good thing for us. Although I am not afraid of these things, it is not a good thing for the Rising Sun Dynasty."
"Yes, I understand. I will go into the palace soon and tell His Majesty that he should make preparations in advance. Should I ask the secret guard to inform His Majesty directly?"
"No, this kind of thing is not suitable for them to know. The reason why I came out of Tingxuan Xiaozhu was because someone was assassinated at that time. Afterwards, His Majesty told me that I was always protected by secret guards. However, the patrol team of the Forbidden Army that rescued me that night included Eunuch Liu, not the secret guards. Although His Majesty explained At that time, all the secret guards were changing shifts, but I didn't believe it. That means someone among the secret guards was a traitor. I have been checking, but the identity of the secret guards is not easy to find, so I don't have any clues yet, and I can't check openly. After all, it is my father's secret, so I still don't trust the secret guards. "
Huyan Moyan also knew for the first time that Xiao Feng was assassinated in the palace, and asked: "Who was the assassin?"
Xiao Feng shook his head, "Father didn't say it clearly, but he should know it. In fact, it doesn't matter to me who it is, but I want to thank him. If it weren't for him, I wouldn't have come out of the cold palace."
Huyan Moyan didn't say anything, just nodded.
Xiao Feng then asked Jia Xu: "Wen He, what do you think of what Yuan Tiangang just said."
Jia Xu thought for a while and then said: "Back to Your Highness, the information Yuan Tiangang just brought is nothing more than two points. The first is that the three dynasties conspired to take action against the Rising Sun Dynasty, and the disappeared masters of the sect are likely to be involved in this matter; the second is that through the competition between the four dynasties, enough trump cards of the Rising Sun Dynasty were tested. However, I always feel that this matter will not be that simple. Without enough benefits, the people of the three dynasties and the sect cannot be so big. Fei Zhouzhang's doing these things should be because someone is inducing these forces to attack the Rising Sun Dynasty, or there is something in the Rising Sun Dynasty that is worthy of being plundered and divided by so many forces. Your Highness, I think you should ask the Jin Yiwei and the bad guys to increase their efforts. Without intelligence, we can't do anything. We can only make some preparations. We are still short of manpower." After saying this, Jia Xu looked at Xiao Feng and gave Xiao Feng a look.
Xiao Feng looked at Jia Xu's eyes and knew what he meant, but he couldn't say it now, so he said, "I know, I will send more people to Yanjing City."
After listening to Jia Xu's analysis, Huyan Moyan also gained a new understanding of Jia Xu. Jia Xu summarized all the news brought by Yuan Tiangang into key information. He and His Majesty can just talk about it directly later.
